entries.fe377a5dda59923c: The business plans, develops, manufactures and sells industrial plastic products as a single segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,403 million. In Japan, products are sold directly and through specialist trading companies and sales agents; overseas, they are sold through consolidated subsidiaries in North America, China, Thailand and other countries.
